title: Snapshot tiles: affirmation states, rollout preview & QA sweep
creator: Morgan Patel
description: Bring snapshot (tile) UI across the Console dashboards closer to launch-ready. This ticket covers final visual-polish pass for the new snapshot tiles used in rollout previews and cost-overview widgets, interaction refinements for the affirmation / success state, updated microcopy for token-level billing hints, and a focused QA sweep for accessibility and responsive breakpoints. Goal: unblock rollout config engineers and PMs with a sign-offable design spec and an actionable redlines document.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype reflects finalized affirmation states (success, partial, failed) with accessible color contrast and updated icons
Microcopy for token billing is reviewed and approved by PM + Legal
Redlines document produced and uploaded to Confluence with measurements and exportable assets for engineering
QA checklist completed (contrast, keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, responsive sizes) and any defects triaged into ENG backlog
Rollout preview interactions (collapsed/expanded, hover affordances, quick actions) pass stakeholder sign-off
comments: 2025-02-12 - Morgan Patel: Created initial ticket after design sync. Attached exploratory prototype and noted outstanding decisions around color tokens and iconography for the affirmation states.

2025-02-13 - Ava Chen: Walked through prototype with PMs (Liam Ortega) and Eng (Sofia Ramos). Agreed to consolidate the three success variants to two (full success / partial) unless QA flags frequent ambiguous cases.

2025-02-14 - Liam Ortega (PM): Requested clearer microcopy for token-level billing — added two options. Asked that wording is A/B testable in rollout preview (option A: short hint; option B: inline info link).

2025-02-15 - Accessibility review (Zoe Park): Redline - increase emphasis border on success tiles at small sizes; ensure focus ring is 3px and has 4.5:1 contrast against background. See Confluence notes.
2025-02-16 - Design review (Ava Chen): Applied visual redlines and delivered updated assets. Split export into SVG icon set and PNG snapshot for legacy consumers. Uploaded redlines doc to Confluence.
2025-02-17 - Engineering (Sofia Ramos): Flagged constraint - current runtime renders tile avatars at fixed 32px, need responsive 24/32/40 variants. Added ENG-10021 to dependencies.

2025-02-18 - QA lead (Diego Silva): Began checklist run. Found two issues: keyboard focus order skips quick-action menu on collapsed tile (high) and cost hint tooltip truncates on 320px width (medium). Logged as ENG defects with links in PR.
2025-02-19 - Morgan Patel: Small copy tweak applied to microcopy (Option B chosen). Confirmed with Legal via Slack thread. Updated Figma component text and versioned file.

2025-02-20 - Ava Chen: Preparing final review package: Figma prototype link, Confluence redlines, asset zip, and targeted QA notes. Requesting stakeholder sign-off by 2025-02-23 to keep release timeline.

Eng to implement responsive avatar sizes (ENG-10021) and address keyboard focus order defect
